system.description: You wrap yourself in the pelt or feathers of a beast.

outcomes.triumph: As Success, but it lasts until you choose to end it or fall asleep.
outcomes.success: For 1 hour, you become an animal of your choice. You gain its senses and movement (flying, swimming and so on), but your mind remains your own.
outcomes.failure: The ritual fails; the pelt is only a pelt.
outcomes.ruin: You transform, but the beast's mind comes too: you are Stupefied for the hour. Roll on the Shadowblight table.
